•Consequently,  the Company  reclassified  its investment  in

non-current  financial  assets .Reclassification of Investment in PlanB

•Registered  and paid-up share  capital  rose from 20,000mn to 21,101mn shares .
•The Company  received  approximately  THB 1,644mn in cash  from the exercise .

142Q 2025/26 PROFIT AND LOSS STATEMENT (CONSO)
*As shown in financial statement, excluding minority interest. •VGI reported revenue from services and sales of THB 1,123mn, 
(-16% YoY).
•Advertising revenue decreased to THB 492mn (-19% YoY) due to 
lower street furniture revenue .The impact was partly offset by higher 
revenue from other media, driving advertising revenue up 8.4% QoQ.
Excluding street furniture, advertising revenue grew 4% YoY.
•Digital Services revenue decreased to THB 364mn (-12% YoY), 
The main reasons include 1)  lower Rcare  revenue and 2) lower 
project management revenue. However, the decline was partially 
supported by higher interest income from RCash .
•Distribution revenue declined to THB 267mn ( -17% YoY). This was 
mainly due to lower Fanslink  revenue and Turtle’s Publishing 
business.
Gross profit margin increased to 34% (from 31% in 2Q 2024/25 ) from 
the improvement in the advertising business as well as better margin 
from Rcash  and Fanslinks .
Other income increased to THB 114mn  (+96% YoY), primarily due to   
higher interest income. 
SG&A was THB 550mn, (+5% YoY), mainly due to an increase in 
marketing expense of Rabbit Group and advertising media management 
fee. SG&A to sales increased to 49% (from 39% YoY)
Share of profit from JVs and associates of THB 110mn (+71% YoY), 
mainly due to share of profit from Plan B Media Public Company Limited  
and Jaymart  Group Holdings Public Company Limited.
•Altogether, VGI reported net profit of THB 79mn, an increase of 0.9% 
YoY, representing a net profit margin of 7.0%.KEY FACTORS (2Q 2025/26 VS 2 Q 2024/25)

19RECOGNITIONS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
2Q 2025/26
VGI received an“Excellent” Corporate
Governance scoring for the 10th
consecutive year in2025 bythe Thai
Institute ofDirectors (IOD) .
VGI received 100 points (Excellent) in 
the 2025 Annual General Meeting (AGM) 
Checklist assessment, reflecting the 
Company’s strong commitment to 
transparency, shareholder engagement, 
and the protection of shareholders’ rights 
in accordance with good corporate 
governance principles.
VGI received the Carbon Footprint for 
Organisation (CFO) certification from the 
Thailand Greenhouse Gas Management 
Organisation (TGO), demonstrating VGI’s strong 
commitment to responsible operations and 
continuous reduction of greenhouse gas 
emissions in support of the Net Zero Emissions 
target.
VGI received an “ESG DNA” certificate from the 
Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET), recognising
the Company’s commitment to integrating 
sustainability principles across its business and 
strengthening long -term responsible growth.
VGI, in collaboration with BTS Group, organised  
the “Clean Air We Share” campaign to 
celebrate both the International Day of Clean Air 
for Blue Skies and the 26th anniversary of the 
BTS SkyTrain service. The event distributed 
more than 4,500 air -purifying plants. Since its 
inception, BTS has served over 4.5bn passenger 
trips and has reduced more than 2mn tonnes  of 
CO2 emissions, equivalent to planting 250mn air -
purifying trees.
